meta.metric: best single hand per ante (chips), extracted from run journals
extraction_notes: Values are the best SINGLE HAND recorded during that ante, taken from each run's journal. null = the run reached that ante but the journal records no usable single-hand number for it.
Antes are as reported by the game at the time (Hieroglyph replays shift the counter; opus5-run4 antes are effective antes as journaled).
michael's runs and the rulebot have endpoint data only (final ante + best hand of the run); endpoint_only=true.
opus5-run2 ante 4 value (69,552) is 'best hand at end of A4' per the journal, so it is a cumulative best through antes 1-4 placed at ante 4. Same for opus5-run5 ante 5 (22,040).
opus5-run5 ante 9 value (799,398) is the run's best hand; the journal states it under ante 9 without naming the exact blind.
opus48-run2 clean (pre-recovery) best was 287,676 at ante 8; antes 9-10 happened after an autosave recovery with a one-line operator hint.
